prefixDef.p: URIs using the q prefix are Wikidata Q identifiers and refer to the respective entries on Wikidata.
Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: HáHere the cat opens its mouth wide in singing. hă hă,
I am the one whom the Lynx derides,
I am the one who did not run fast;
For, the Lynx is the one who runs fast,
I am the one whom the Lynx derides.
I am the one whom the Lynx derides.
I am the one who could not run fast,
I am the one whom the Lynx derides,
The Cat is the one whom the Lynx derides,
"It is the one who could not run fast,"
"The Cat is the one who could not run fast,
For, the Lynx is one who understands,
The Cat is the one about whom the Lynx talked.
"It is the one who could not run fast."
It had to be cunning.Reference is here made to the Cat's way of doubling when pursued.
HágglaThe narrator here explains that the Cat "talks with its tongue", assenting to what it has been saying. hággla hággla
